Listen up, troopers! A major update has been released, adding a ton of improvements and (free) new content! Many of the campaign and challenge missions have been updated and now include new player units. In particular the Kwalasha and Gehenna campaigns have seen significant changes and now use the Materiel resource as a requisite to deploying turrets and advanced units. In addition to all of the above, this update includes significant performance improvements, specifically targeting the slowdowns you may experience during long play sessions and on larger maps. Note that due to all these changes savegames from previous versions are no longer compatible. If you try to load an older savegame you will get a prompt to restart the scenario instead. Below is a selection of missions that highlight these new units as well as some of the units that have received significant design changes.

This light weapon platform provides deadly fire support against lightly armored ground targets.

Its quad machine guns also excel against Hoppers and other airborne targets.

Deploy this biped when you are in need of long range fire support.

Its heavy mortar can engage targets from a long distance, making it particularly effective against Plasma Grenadiers.

The M6A Jaeger is equipped with a powerful anti-armor cannon, effective against heavy targets like Scorpion Bugs.

It also deploys a spotter drone to distract nearby enemies.

Though bulkier than Powered Suits, E-Pulse Troopers offer strong frontline defense.

Their heavy armor provides solid protection against high-tier Arachnids like Scorpions and Royal Guards.

The reworked mercenary squad is armed with a variety of weapons to deal with different target types.

This mission also introduces the enlarged and up-armored “Drilling Biped”.
This specialist eliminates Arachnids from long range using incendiary rounds, while its companion drone provides spotting and close range fire support.

This variant of the M11 Marauder is now equipped with dual flamethrowers, resulting in unmatched close-range firepower.

It also has the ability to drop an incendiary bomb that sets the surrounding area ablaze.

Now fully dedicated to its role as a ground-attack gunship, the Pegasus can no longer engage airborne targets.

Instead, you can set it up to unleash relentless rocket barrages on a designated target area.
